pc_medium._todo: OQ-WEB-GFX-PRESETS (W1a): the PC Medium quality level. Every value that differs from "default" is a guess for Shibi (see _pc_keys_note for each key's OQ id); the art_* and fx_* switches are copied from "default".

pc_high._todo: OQ-WEB-GFX-PRESETS (W1a): the PC High quality level (Auto on a PC or in a browser, OQ-WEB-GFX-AUTO). Every value that differs from "default" is a guess for Shibi (see _pc_keys_note for each key's OQ id); the art_* and fx_* switches are copied from "default".

_auto_pc_note: OQ-WEB-GFX-AUTO (placeholder, a guess for Shibi): the preset Auto picks on a PC or in a browser (PlatformServices.is_pc(); scripts/systems/graphics_presets.gd choose_id). Anything else (and every headless run) keeps "default". A saved graphics_quality other than "" (Auto) wins on a PC.
_pc_keys_note: W1a keys (placeholders, guesses for Shibi). LIVE = applied at once by GraphicsPresets.apply(); NEXT MATCH = read when the match look is built (scripts/visual/greybox_art.gd _apply_environment). A key a preset leaves out (the "default" preset has no vsync, anisotropic_level, directional_shadow_size, shadow_mode or shadow_max_distance_m) means the project's own setting (ProjectSettings) for the LIVE keys and today's data/art_astra.json environment values for the NEXT MATCH keys. vsync (OQ-WEB-GFX-FPS, LIVE, DisplayServer.window_set_vsync_mode; a browser always presents on requestAnimationFrame, so it changes nothing there); max_fps (OQ-WEB-GFX-FPS, LIVE, Engine.max_fps, 0 = no cap; the profile's frame_cap replaces it on a PC); msaa_3d (OQ-WEB-GFX-AA, LIVE, Viewport.msaa_3d: 0, 2, 4 or 8); anisotropic_level (OQ-WEB-GFX-AA, LIVE, Viewport.anisotropic_filtering_level: 1 = off, 2, 4, 8 or 16); directional_shadow_size (OQ-WEB-GFX-SHADOWS, LIVE, RenderingServer.directional_shadow_atlas_set_size, pixels per side); shadow_mode (OQ-WEB-GFX-SHADOWS, NEXT MATCH, "pssm2" or "pssm4" = DirectionalLight3D parallel 2 or 4 splits; absent = art_astra.json environment.shadow_mode, orthogonal today); shadow_max_distance_m (OQ-WEB-GFX-SHADOWS, NEXT MATCH, DirectionalLight3D.directional_shadow_max_distance; absent = art_astra.json environment.shadow_max_distance_m, 70 m today); scale_3d (OQ-WEB-GFX-SCALE, LIVE, Viewport.scaling_3d_scale, times the profile's render_scale on a PC). No preset turns on an fx_* key.
_show_advanced_graphics_note: OQ-WEB-GFX-ADVANCED (placeholder, a decision for Shibi): true shows the Field of view and Render scale rows and the 144 / Unlimited frame caps in Settings (PC only); false keeps them built but hidden.
_frame_caps_note: OQ-WEB-GFX-FPS (placeholders): the Frame cap row's choices (fps; 0 = Unlimited). The profile's frame_cap (default 60, scripts/systems/save_service.gd) must be one of frame_caps + advanced_frame_caps. Engine.max_fps is set either way; whether a browser honours it is measured in a later step.

render_scale._note: OQ-WEB-GFX-SCALE (placeholder): the Render scale row (profile render_scale, default 1.0); multiplies the preset's scale_3d (Viewport.scaling_3d_scale), LIVE.

_keys_note: OQ-GFX-PRESETS (placeholders): art_glow_enabled = bloom (a full-screen blur chain: the most expensive switch here on the Mobile renderer); art_grade_enabled = brightness / contrast / saturation in the tonemap pass; art_weather_enabled = dust motes or rain particles around the camera; art_shafts_enabled = additive sun shaft quads; art_vignette_enabled = one blended full-screen rectangle; art_backdrop_enabled = the outer wall ring, towers, spires, far aqueduct, hills and ground skirt beyond the playable square (five batches and two meshes, no shadows); art_debanding_enabled = dithering of smooth gradients in the tonemap pass (the match's viewport); art_world_kit_enabled = M2W1: the wall, stair, gate and tower pieces draw the Blender looks of data/art_world_kit.json (more triangles near, a far LOD batch per type and chunk) instead of the kit's box looks (read at map build); art_ground_detail_enabled = M2W1: the ground's detail path (data/art_ground_detail.json: macro patches at three scales, rock on slopes, paving edges, near grain, distance fade; 8 texture fetches per ground pixel instead of 6; off = the S2 ground; read when a map's ground material is made); art_clutter_enabled = M2W1 item 5: the low camp dressing and field scatter of data/art_clutter.json on maps with a block there (more MultiMesh batches with a short range, no shadows; read at map build); fx_ssr_enabled, fx_ssao_enabled, fx_ssil_enabled and fx_volumetric_fog_enabled = effects only the Forward+ renderer draws (off for the Mobile renderer; OQ-GFX-RENDERER). Each may be turned off without touching code.
_note: TODO OQ-40: the presets and the 60 fps cap are placeholders, not design values.
